# DIC tensor detector: native-resolution WebGPU baseline

Adapter: Vulkan (Intel(R) Graphics (LNL)). Inference runs on source images at native resolution. Medians use 3 calls after one warm-up. The full detector time includes texture upload, allocations, WGSL dispatches, and the small selected-point readback.
